plate_is_insufficient.ship: bare but one — clitellum only, until a replacement plate arrives
plate_is_insufficient.why: The plate is a whole-body silhouette. Eighteen of its nineteen terms (prostomium, peristomium, mouth, anus, seta, genital papilla, and all three pore types) need an identifiable ANTERIOR END, and this drawing does not have one. The clitellum sits at 55-62% of body length; in Pheretima it is at segments 14-16, about 13%. Neither end of the drawing is consistent with that, so naming either one 'prostomium' is a coin flip on which end is the head — and a correct word on the wrong end is the worst thing this pipeline can ship. Raasikh regenerates the plate separately; nothing here is a placement problem to solve.
